arxiv-2112-04602.title: Adaptive packet transmission in response to anomaly detection in software defined smart meter networks Conference: CoNEXT ’18; December 4–7, 2018; Heraklion/Crete, Greece Price: TBA DOI: TBA ISBN: TBA
arxiv-2112-04602.creator: Mihnea Maris, Thomas Halpin, Dubem Ezeh, Karen Miu and Jaudelice de Oliveira
arxiv-2112-04602.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mihnea Maris, Thomas Halpin, Dubem Ezeh, Karen Miu and Jaudelice de Oliveira. In this paper, we examine a basic smart meter network topology in mininet and address the issue of congestion over a commodity network, proposing an adaptive algorithm to cope with varying grid data delivery latencies. Introduction

In modern power distribution systems, smart meters are becoming increasingly common as utility companies increase the utilization of real-time Automatic Meter Readings (AMR) to better understand power usage and make informed control decisions.

arxiv-2212-02580.title: Simulating Cumulus Clouds based on Self-Organized Criticality
arxiv-2212-02580.creator: J. Cheraghalizadeh, M. Luković, M. N. Najafi
arxiv-2212-02580.description: Abstract Recently it was shown that self-organized criticality is an important ingredient of the dynamics of cumulus clouds (Physical Review E, 103(5), p.052106, 2021). Here we introduce a new algorithm to simulate cumulus clouds in two-dimensional square lattices, based on two important facts: the cohesive energy of wet air parcels and a sandpile-type diffusion of cloud segments.

We thank Mike West and confere
arxiv-2311-12671.description: Abstract Bayesian predictive synthesis (BPS) provides a method for combining multiple predictive distributions based on agent/expert opinion analysis theory and encompasses a range of existing density forecast pooling methods. The key ingredient in BPS is a “synthesis” function. This is typically specified parametrically as a dynamic linear regression.

arxiv-2409-02829.title: Green’s Function Approach to Model Vibrations of Beams with Spatiotemporally Modulated Properties
arxiv-2409-02829.creator: Benjamin M. Goldsberry 1 , Andrew N. Norris 2 , Samuel P. Wallen 1 , and Michael R. Haberman 1,3
arxiv-2409-02829.description: Abstract The forced time harmonic response of a spatiotemporally-modulated elastic beam of finite length with light damping is derived using a novel Green’s function approach. Closed-form solutions are found that highlight unique mode coupling effects that are induced by spatiotemporal modulation, such as split resonances that are tunable with the modulation parameters.

pmc-10670085.title: Rab Geranylgeranyltransferase Subunit Beta as a Potential Indicator to Assess the Progression of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
pmc-10670085.creator: Jing Yang, Cheng Xin, Jia Huo, Xin Li, Hui Dong, Qi Liu, Rui Li, Yaling Liu, Deepshikha Pande Katare, Francesca Trojsi
pmc-10670085.description: Background: Currently, there is no effective treatment for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a devastating neurodegenerative disorder. Many biomarkers have been proposed, but because ALS is a clinically heterogeneous disease with an unclear etiology, biomarker discovery for ALS has been challenging due to the lack of specificity of these biomarkers.

pmc-11310430.title: Caplan Syndrome Mimicking Progressive Massive Fibrosis on CT: A Case Report
pmc-11310430.creator: Jinwook Baek, Ji-Yeon Han
pmc-11310430.description: This report presents a unique case of Caplan syndrome that mimicked accelerated progressive massive fibrosis. The patient, a former coal miner, had been diagnosed with coal worker’s pneumoconiosis 15 years prior and had been treated for rheumatoid arthritis for over 20 years.

pmc-11691359.title: QUADRICEPS MUSCLE THICKNESS MEASURED BY POINT-OF-CARE ULTRASOUND AND HOSPITAL LENGTH OF STAY
pmc-11691359.creator: Uyanga Ganbat, Altan-Ochir Byambaa, Graydon Meneilly
pmc-11691359.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAccurate prediction of hospital length of stay (LOS) and readmission rates could help improve effective healthcare resource allocation. Recent evidence suggests point-of-care ultrasound for muscle assessment, specifically muscle thickness, as a promising tool in this regard. This study explores the hypothesis that ultrasound measurements of quadriceps muscle thickness (MT) and echointensity (EI) can serve as predictors for these crucial patient outcomes.

pmc-12363123.title: Automated planning and scheduling in robot-aided rehabilitation: a review
pmc-12363123.creator: Christian Tamantini, Alessandro Umbrico, Andrea Orlandini
pmc-12363123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Robotic systems are increasingly utilized in rehabilitation contexts, offering tailored support for physical and cognitive functions. Enabling these systems to autonomously personalize treatments entails a critical role for automated planning and scheduling methodologies. However, a comprehensive review to map the control architectures of robotic rehabilitation systems that leverage automated planning for long-term customization is lacking, addressing a key gap in the literature.

pmc-12632070.title: Prevalence and determinants of insecticide-treated bed-net utilization among under-five children in Ethiopia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12632070.creator: Amlaku Nigusie Yirsaw, Lakew Asmare, Eyob Getachew, Zeamanuel Anteneh Yigzaw, Tihtna Alemu, Gebeyehu Lakew
pmc-12632070.description: BackgroundMalaria continues to be a significant public health challenge in Ethiopia, especially among children under the age of five, who are more vulnerable to the disease. Insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) are widely recommended as an effective preventive measure. However, studies in Ethiopia have reported inconsistent findings regarding ITN utilization among under-five children.

pmc-13111150.title: QKAN: quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold networks with applications in machine learning and multivariate state preparation
pmc-13111150.creator: Petr Ivashkov, Po-Wei Huang, Kelvin Koor, Lirandë Pira, Patrick Rebentrost
pmc-13111150.description: We introduce quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (QKAN), a quantum algorithmic framework inspired by the recently proposed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN). QKAN inherits the compositional structure of KAN and is based on block-encodings, constructed recursively from a single layer using quantum singular value transformation. We demonstrate the algorithmic utility of QKAN in two applications.

pmc-13357378.title: Mitochondrial dynamics imbalance in hepatocellular carcinoma: from molecular mechanisms to new strategies for targeted therapy
pmc-13357378.creator: Fuxiang Chen, Chunyang Ma, Xitong Bo, Yilong Zhou, Suqing Zhang
pmc-13357378.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), a malignancy with high global mortality, exhibits a close association with mitochondrial dynamic imbalance. Mitochondria maintain cellular homeostasis through a dynamic equilibrium of fission and fusion, and dysregulation of this process can trigger metabolic reprogramming, oxidative stress, and dysregulation of multiple modes of cell death, ultimately driving HCC progression.
